visual_action: The video opens with a news clip of Donald Trump speaking outdoors in front of a helicopter. A chyron is at the bottom of the screen. The video then cuts to a fast-paced montage of still photos of Trump set to music. The photos include Trump on a golf course, a close-up of his face with a red filter, a close-up of his hands, and him speaking at a rally. Each photo in the montage has an overlay of text from a news headline.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown speaking in a news clip at the beginning, his name appears in the chyron ('PRES. TRUMP'), and he is the subject of the entire montage of photos and critical headlines.

spoken_summary: The video opens with Donald Trump saying, "Just one negative number. All of the numbers seem to be great." This is immediately followed by a loud musical drop with the lyrics "Turn down for what."
audio_music: The video begins with dialogue from Donald Trump. After he speaks, a high-energy electronic hip-hop track with a heavy beat begins abruptly. The track prominently features the well-known vocal sample "Turn down for what." The music serves to create a jarring, mocking contrast with Trump's optimistic statement.
editing_pacing: The video starts with a static news clip, then transitions into a fast-paced montage of still images with quick cuts synchronized to a heavy beat.
cultural_references: The song sample "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake and Lil Jon.
central_claim: Donald Trump's positive claims about the economy were contradicted by poor job reports, which he responded to by firing the head of the reporting agency.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as dishonest and incompetent regarding his management of the economy.
